 News › News News › Main 2027 Registration Begins: NTA advises candidates to complete Aadhaar re-KYC via DigiLocker Main 2027 Registration Begins: NTA advises candidates to complete Aadhaar re-KYC via DigiLocker
 TNN Updated: Oct 29, 2026, 12:27 IST The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially commenced the registration process for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session 1 on its official portal, jeemain.nta.nic.in
 . Ahead of submitting the online application, aspirants are strongly advised to complete their Aadhaar re-KYC update through DigiLocker to ensure seamless verification and prevent biometric or identity discrepancies during later stages of the admission cycle.
 According to the official NTA advisory, applicants must log in using their personal DigiLocker, JanParichay, or e-Pramaan (MeriPehchaan) credentials. 
 Third-party logins or mismatched profiles may disrupt candidate authentication and identity validation.
 Key Registration Guidelines 
 · Use Personal Credentials: Candidates must use their own DigiLocker, JanParichay, or e-Pramaan credentials to avoid identity and biometric mismatch issues during examination check-ins and counseling.
 · Pre-Application Aadhaar Re-KYC: Aspirants must update their Aadhaar status on DigiLocker before filling out the JEE Main 2027 form so the portal can automatically pull verified, up-to-date information.
 · Strict Match with Class 10 Records: The candidate's name, parent details, and date of birth entered in the JEE Main application form must strictly match the details printed on their class X certificate or marksheet.
 · Official Notifications: Applicants should check jeemain.nta.nic.in regularly for updates, corrections, and examination schedules.
 How to Complete Aadhaar Re-KYC via DigiLocker 
 1.Access your account on the DigiLocker app or official website and head to the Issued Documents tab.
 2.Locate your Aadhaar entry, click the three-dot action menu adjacent to it, and select Refresh.
 3.Read through the UIDAI consent prompt and confirm approval to begin authentication.
 4.Input the one-time password sent to the mobile number linked with your Aadhaar to authorize e-KYC.
 5.Wait for the system to process the request and display the verified status.
 6.Once Aadhaar re-KYC is confirmed, refresh other issued certificates (such as marksheets) to align all profile records.
 Exam Schedule 
 The NTA will organise the engineering entrance examination across two distinct sessions:
 · Session 1: January 2027
 · Session 2: April 2027
 Eligible candidates can complete the Session 1 registration directly at jeemain.nta.nic.in .
